reviewItem.question: For "Storage version of `clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io` changes v1beta1 → v1", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The storage version of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1 (in chart 0.16.0 the CRD no longer marks v1beta1 as storage, true → false), so existing ClusterExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration (re-write all objects) is run and status.storedVersions is updated, which must happen before a later release removes v1beta1.
